title: Keep a study group moving
brief: My adult-learning group struggles to choose topics, schedule practice, and share progress without another chat thread.

target_population.role: facilitator of a twelve-member adult conversational-Spanish circle
target_population.coverage_limit: one group of at most twenty members; no accounts, messaging, or notifications

core_task.summary: propose a session topic and record a member's vote on the open ballot
core_task.success_oracle: proposing a topic adds it to the open ballot with a zero tally and casting a vote updates that topic's tally immediately

not_applicable_states.loading: the roster, sessions, and ballot are seeded local data mutated in memory, so voting and proposing render their result in the same frame

state_recipes.empty: open the next-session panel after clearing both seeded proposals; the panel invites the first proposal of the week
state_recipes.validation-error: submit the proposal form with a blank topic; an inline error keeps the ballot unchanged
state_recipes.success: propose 'Ordering at a restaurant' and vote for it; the tally shows one vote credited
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the proposal field shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the board at 390x844; the ballot stacks above the member progress grid

acceptance_facts: The seed defines a twelve-member roster, five past sessions, and two open topic proposals.
Proposing a topic appends it to the open ballot with a zero tally and the proposer's name attached.
Each member row shows a weekly practice streak and the seeded group median streak is four weeks.

product_signature.mechanism: topic ballot that turns member votes into the next session plan
product_signature.anchor: next-session panel at the top of the board
product_signature.brief_trace: struggles to choose topics, schedule practice, and share progress
product_signature.counterfactual: a shared calendar alone would satisfy a scheduling brief but cannot rank what the group studies next
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the new topic on the ballot with its first vote counted

anti_goals: no chat thread, comments, or direct messages
no user accounts, logins, or member permissions
no gamified points, badges, or leaderboards beyond the plain streak count

content_seed.data_notes: twelve invented members total; the two seeded proposals fix the ballot the core task extends to three
